headline: Water at dawn, tip canes — 97°F through Thursday.
weather_notes: Run both zones before 9 AM — 2 days without irrigation at 97°F exceeds the 1-day heat threshold; don't rely on today's 26% afternoon storm chance.
Finish all outdoor tasks before 9 AM — highs climb from 97°F today to 100°F Thursday with zero precipitation, closing every afternoon window.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM — 38-day transplants under sustained 97–100°F remain at sunscald and blossom-drop risk through the week.
Check potato bags for moisture Thursday — 100°F with no rain dries container soil faster than raised beds; don't skip that day's check.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 18 days overdue — tip before today's afternoon storms close the outdoor window; further delay risks canes outgrowing the tipping window and losing next year's lateral branching.

suggested_tasks.title: Check w4 onions for harvest readiness
suggested_tasks.description: At 94 days, Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish are entering their maturity window — look for softening necks and falling tops as the signal to bend stems and begin curing.

suggested_tasks.title: Watch potato bags for dying tops
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 70 days is entering the 65–80 day harvest window — check daily for yellowing or collapsing foliage as the cue to stop hilling and begin harvest.
